decisions.decision: Cross-repo quick tasks (frontend-only changes in MINIREDESOCIAL_FRONT) run WITHOUT worktree isolation
decisions.rationale: Worktree isolation creates a worktree of the BACKEND repo (miniredesocial); it cannot safely span into a separate sibling git repo. Executor edits MINIREDESOCIAL_FRONT directly on its main branch and commits there per-task via git -C

decisions.decision: SendHorizontal (lucide-react v0.400.0, already installed) used instead of a CSS rotate transform on the Send icon
decisions.rationale: Cleaner swap, no new dependency, icon is purpose-drawn pointing right

decisions.decision: Profile photo viewer modal applies only to the NON-owner avatar tap on ProfilePage; owner avatar tap continues to open the file picker (change photo) unchanged
decisions.rationale: Preserves existing change-photo affordance for the logged-in user; the new viewer modal covers viewing OTHER users' photos
